items.headline: Hardcourt season is back — and the DC Open opens with a Tiafoe stunner
items.body: The US summer hardcourt swing — the runway to the US Open — is underway, and the DC Open kicked off with a jolt: American home-favorite and sixth seed Frances Tiafoe got bounced in the first round by France's Terence Atmane, 4-6, 6-3, 6-4, his earliest Washington exit since 2021. The field's stacked with Taylor Fritz, Ben Shelton and Naomi Osaka, so there's plenty more to watch all week in Rock Creek Park.
items.say: Tennis is back with the summer hardcourt stuff leading into the US Open, and one of the American favorites, Tiafoe, already got knocked out in the first round in DC. Osaka and Fritz are playing too. You watch any tennis?

links.text: Washington Times · Tiafoe upset by Atmane in DC Open stunner

items.headline: Four homers in three innings — the Rangers ambush George Kirby
items.body: Somebody forgot to tell Texas that George Kirby owns them. The Mariners ace had gone 9-1 with a tiny ERA in his career against the Rangers, then got tagged for four home runs in the first three innings Monday night. Joc Pederson went deep twice, with Ezequiel Duran and Jake Burger adding their own, in a 7-3 win that shoved the sliding Mariners further back and handed Texas control of the AL West race.
items.say: The Rangers hit four homers off Seattle's ace in like three innings last night — and the guy had basically never lost to them before. Joc Pederson homered twice. It's flipping the whole AL West race. You following the pennant races?

links.text: MLB.com · Rangers hit four home runs off Kirby

items.headline: MLS vs. Liga MX — the All-Star Game lands in Charlotte on Wednesday
items.body: Soccer's summer showcase is here: the MLS All-Star Game pits the league's best against a Liga MX All-Star squad Wednesday night at Charlotte's Bank of America Stadium. It's the fifth time the two leagues have squared off in this cross-border format — MLS leads the all-time series 3-1 after winning in Austin last year — and it's always a fun, feisty, bragging-rights night on both sides of the border.
items.say: The MLS All-Star Game's Wednesday night — the US league's best against Mexico's Liga MX all-stars, which always gets a little chippy. Good one to throw on. You catch any MLS?

links.text: MLSSoccer.com · MLS vs. Liga MX: what to know

items.headline: Counter-Strike heads to Malta — the BLAST Bounty LAN finals start Thursday
items.body: The summer's CS2 storyline moves off your screen and into the sunshine: eight teams survived the online qualifier and now land in Malta for the BLAST Bounty Summer LAN finals, running Thursday through the weekend. Heavyweights like FaZe, Astralis and MOUZ are in the field — and Team Liquid arrive with a spring in their step after stunning tournament favorite Vitality to punch their ticket. Perfect low-stakes-but-spicy CS to have on this week.
items.say: Counter-Strike's got its LAN finals in Malta this week — the eight best teams left, and Liquid's rolling in hot after knocking out the favorites to get there. Good background watching. You keeping up with CS?

links.text: Egamersworld · Eight teams advance to the Malta LAN finals

items.headline: Mahomes is cleared — and the Chiefs are back on the practice field
items.body: Real football is creeping back: NFL camps are in full swing this week, and the biggest name is a go. Patrick Mahomes has been fully cleared to practice after tearing his ACL and LCL late last season, opening camp in a brace and building back toward Week 1. Head coach Andy Reid says he's optimistic Mahomes will be ready for the opener — so the entire Chiefs season just exhaled.
items.say: NFL camps are underway and the big news is Mahomes got fully cleared after that knee injury that ended his year. He's back practicing in a brace. If you're a football person, that's a huge one. You following your team's camp?

items.headline: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' swings into theaters Friday
items.body: The movie event of the summer arrives Friday: Tom Holland is back as Peter Parker in 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day,' set four years after 'No Way Home' with Peter now living alone in a New York that's forgotten who he is. Zendaya, Sadie Sink and Jacob Batalon co-star and Destin Daniel Cretton directs — and the hype is very real, with its trailer becoming the most-watched movie trailer of all time (a staggering 718 million views in a single day).
items.say: The new Spider-Man, 'Brand New Day,' comes out Friday — Tom Holland's back, and the trailer literally broke the all-time record, like 700 million views in a day. Everyone's going to be talking about it this weekend. You gonna see it?

items.headline: Gotham gets darker — 'Batman: Caped Crusader' returns for Season 2 Friday
items.body: For the animation crowd, the slick noir 'Batman: Caped Crusader' drops its second season on Prime Video on Friday. This run has Batman and his allies going after crime boss Rupert Thorne's empire — and the new trailer teases a fresh, genuinely unsettling take on the Joker lurking in the shadows. It's the moody, hand-drawn, 1940s-styled Batman from Bruce Timm, J.J. Abrams and Matt Reeves, and it's a treat even if you're cartooned-out.
items.say: The animated 'Batman: Caped Crusader' is back for season two on Friday — that gorgeous 1940s noir style, and this one finally brings in the Joker. Great even if you don't usually do cartoons. You catch the first season?

items.headline: Netflix's 'The Bombing of Pan Am 103' — the true Lockerbie story lands Thursday
items.body: The week's big prestige drama: Netflix's six-part 'The Bombing of Pan Am 103' premieres Thursday, retelling the 1988 Lockerbie tragedy and the dogged, decades-long investigation to bring those responsible to justice. It stars Connor Swindells and Patrick J. Adams and centers on the Scottish and American investigators who refused to let the case go. Gripping, true-story television for when you want something with real weight.
items.say: There's a big Netflix series out Thursday about the Lockerbie bombing — 'The Bombing of Pan Am 103' — that follows the investigators who spent years chasing the case. Supposed to be really gripping. You into the true-story stuff?

items.headline: 50 Cent's boxing revenge saga 'Fightland' hits Starz on Friday
items.body: If you want something pulpier, 50 Cent's new British crime drama 'Fightland' premieres Friday on Starz. Howard Charles plays Duke Kilroy, a heavyweight champ whose life implodes after his brother is killed — and who comes out of prison to burn down the London crime boss he blames for it. It's gritty, fast and exactly the kind of high-stakes binge 50 Cent's shows are known for.
items.say: 50 Cent's got a new boxing crime drama on Starz Friday called 'Fightland' — a heavyweight champ out for revenge in the London underworld. Looks like a fun, pulpy binge. You watch any of his shows?
